OpenAI-Compatible HTTP Coding Backend

Source: R/backends.R
backend_openai.Rd

Creates a hardened backend targeting any OpenAI-compatible /chat/completions API (OpenAI, Azure OpenAI proxies, vLLM, OpenRouter, Together, LiteLLM, or local servers) using httr2 with strict URL/header validation, sealed API-key redaction, bounded response sizes, and jittered exponential backoff retries.

Usage

backend_openai(
  model = "gpt-4o-mini",
  api_key = Sys.getenv("OPENAI_API_KEY"),
  base_url = "https://api.openai.com/v1",
  system_prompt = "Return only valid JSON matching the coding schema.",
  response_format = c("json_schema", "json_object", "none"),
  timeout = 60,
  max_retries = 3L,
  backoff_base = 1,
  max_response_bytes = 1048576L,
  extra_headers = list(),
  extra_body = list(),
  transport = NULL
)

Arguments

model

Default model identifier (overridden by design model column when code_texts() runs multi-model designs).

api_key

API key string (wrapped in a non-printable redacted container; never echoed in print(), summary(), cache keys, or errors). Defaults to Sys.getenv("OPENAI_API_KEY").

base_url

Base HTTP/HTTPS API URL without trailing slash.

system_prompt

Optional system instruction prepended to every request.

response_format

Structured output mode: "json_schema" (default), "json_object", or "none".

timeout

Request timeout in seconds. Default 60.

max_retries

Maximum HTTP retry attempts on transient errors.

backoff_base

Base backoff seconds for jittered exponential retry.

max_response_bytes

Maximum allowed response payload size in bytes. Default 1048576L (1 MiB).

extra_headers

Optional named list of additional HTTP headers (checked against CRLF/control-character injection).

extra_body

Optional named list merged into the JSON request body.

transport

Optional custom transport function function(req_spec) returning a parsed list response (intended for offline testing/mocking).

Value

An object of class c("llm_backend_openai", "llm_backend").

Examples

b <- backend_openai(model = "gpt-4o-mini", api_key = "demo-key")
b
#> 
#> ── LLM Backend (openai) 
#> ID: openai_d68c21a472ee
#> Model: gpt-4o-mini | Endpoint: https://api.openai.com/v1 | API key: <redacted>
#> | Timeout: 60s
